programme.title: Made In America

programme.title: Traffic

programme.title: Last Knights

programme.title: Transformers: Armada: Desperate

programme.title: Magi-Nation
programme.desc: In Arderial searching for that realm's lost Dreamstone, Tony, Edyn and Strag are attacked by a bizarre creature with traits from multiple realms. A Book of Elders clue leads them to believe that this creature is the key to finding the Dreamstone.

programme.title: Kung Fu Dino Posse

programme.title: Kung Fu Dino Posse
programme.desc: As the KFDP headquarters becomes more modernized, Kane feels like he’s losing touch with his dino roots. So he announces to the others that he’s moving out… into a rustic cave on the outskirts of town just like back in the good old prehistoric days.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada: Mars
programme.desc: Alexis tracks a minicon in the vicinity of Mars. Starscream gets there first, but is disabled by Tidalwave. Jetfire rescues him: on the way back Starscream spots and tries to entice the minicon. But first they must get past Megatron.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS: Neutralized

programme.title: Magi-Nation

programme.title: Kung Fu Dino Posse
programme.desc: Skor decides that if he can’t beat the Kung Fu Dino Posse, he might as well make fools of them – literally. Thanks to an unstable new cloning device, Skor makes clones of all four Dinos – and turns them into clowns.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS: The Reveal

programme.title: Kung Fu Dino Posse

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS: The Lost Incident

programme.title: Street Sharks

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS: Truth and Consequences

programme.title: Magi-Nation

programme.title: Transformers: Armada: Trust

programme.title: Kung Fu Dino Posse
